intuition: The next output node is the smallest current head among all nonempty lists.

brute_force.approach: Collect all node values, sort them, and build a merged list.

optimal.approach: Keep one current node per list in a min-heap, repeatedly pop the smallest and push its successor. Divide and conquer is an alternative with O(n log k) time.

edge_cases: An empty collection or a collection of empty lists returns None.
The heap tuple uses a list index to break equal-value ties because ListNode instances are not orderable.
Push a successor only after removing its predecessor from the heap.
